description: This file defines the internal extension class for stream consumers in Orleans, including handling stream subscriptions, delivering items, batches, completion, and error signaling to stream observers, as well as managing associated logging and subscription states.

classes.name: StreamConsumerExtension
classes.description: Internal class that manages stream subscriptions, message delivery, and observer interactions within Orleans streams infrastructure.

methods.name: SetObserver
methods.description: Associates a new observer with a stream subscription, creating a subscription handle.

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes the associated observer from the subscription list.

methods.name: DeliverImmutable
methods.description: Delivers an immutable item to the stream, internally calls DeliverMutable.

methods.name: DeliverMutable
methods.description: Delivers a mutable item to the stream subscriber, also handling dynamic subscription setup if necessary.

methods.name: DeliverBatch
methods.description: Delivers a batch of messages to the stream subscriber.

methods.name: CompleteStream
methods.description: Signals stream completion to the subscriber.

methods.name: ErrorInStream
methods.description: Signals an error in the stream to the subscriber.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current sequence token for a given subscription.
